tagline: West New York sanctuary crafting cozy coffee and legendary house bakes.
address: 158 61st St, West New York, NJ 07093, USA

storyBlock.headline: A Warm Corner of West New York Crafted for Comfort.
storyBlock.narrative: From our legendary house-baked banana bread to meticulously poured rosemary maple lattes, every offering is rooted in quality and genuine hospitality. We invite you to slow down, savor the moment, and feel right at home.

auditNotes: Current website relies on a stark yellow single-page card layout that lacks immersive storytelling about your warm interior and menu highlights.
Menu and operating hours require extra clicks or external lookups instead of providing an effortless mobile-first browsing experience.

services.name: Rosemary Maple Latte
services.description: Meticulously poured espresso infused with warm maple syrup and subtle fresh rosemary essence.

services.name: Legendary House Banana Bread
services.description: Warm, thick-sliced banana bread baked fresh every morning from our signature family recipe.

services.name: Small-Batch Steeped Cold Brew
services.description: Slow-steeped for 18 hours using ethical single-origin beans for an ultra-smooth, complex finish.

services.name: Artisanal Sourdough Toast
services.description: Thick-cut rustic sourdough served warm with whipped honey butter or seasoned avocado mash.

reviews.author: Harper Meehan
reviews.text:
Stumbled upon this cafe while we were visiting for a few days. We tried the Rosemary Maple latte, cinnamon maple latte, grilled cheese, chia seed pudding and banana bread. This was the BEST banana bread I have ever had.

This cafe is locally and family owned.

reviews.author: Gabe Raybould
reviews.text: Malpa Cafe is the best!! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it the perfect place to slow down, enjoy a coffee, and have something delicious to eat. You can the owners put a heavy emphasis on quality ingredients when it comes to the coffee and the food
